caption: Paleis Het Loo, Apeldoorn
composition: Garden axis at night, brick palace and clipped parterres · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the baroque garden the symmetrical brick palace closes the axis, with clipped evergreen parterres and a still fountain basin. The gardens are closed at this hour, so the basin is not spraying and there is no summer flower show. It is clear, about 13.5°C, with a light wind near 5.4 km/h. Sunset was 19:27. The glass forecourt of the renovation is not this view.
